usage: ansible <host-pattern> [options]

Options:
  -m NAME, --module-name NAME       module to execute (default=command)
  -a ARGS, --args ARGS              the module arguments
  -i INVENTORY, --inventory-file INVENTORY
  -u USER, --user USER              remote user to use (default=root)
  -k, --ask-pass                    ask for password
  -K, --ask-become-pass             ask for privilege escalation password
  -C, --check                       don't make any changes
  -f FORKS, --forks FORKS           specify number of parallel processes
  -l LABEL, --limit LABEL           limit selected hosts to an additional pattern
  -v, --verbose                     verbose mode (-vvv for more, -vvvv to enable connection debugging)
